figurative_meaning_bn: অসার বস্তুগ্রহণ; সার জিনিস থেকে বঞ্চিত হওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: Accepting worthless things; being deprived of valuable or essential items
similar_in_english: getting the short end of the stick
example_sentences_in_bangla: সময়মতো না এলে এখন আঁটি চোষা করতে হবে।
সে সঠিক সুযোগ ছেড়ে দিয়েছে, এখন আঁটি চোষা করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: If you don't act on time, you'll end up sucking on husks.
He missed the right opportunity and now he's settling for worthless scraps.
history: This idiom originates from agrarian Bengali culture, where rice husks (আঁটি) are the indigestible, worthless byproduct of rice processing, symbolizing futile efforts or settling for nothing substantial.
note: Often used to caution against procrastination or poor choices leading to subpar outcomes.
